name: card_post_project_visual_devices_website
title: Card Post Project Visual - Devices Website
description: Renders a project's website preview as a laptop + phone device mockup (formerly card_post_project_visual_website). Device model (per type) is auto-picked from the project's type/start year, or can be forced. Device frame images come from data_content_post_projects.json (img.devices). Set "link": false to render it without the link (e.g. inside project_feature_hero).
